newsitem.title: USA: Gingrich optimistic on vote for U.S. House speaker.
newsitem.headline: Gingrich optimistic on vote for U.S. House speaker.

text.p: House Speaker Newt Gingrich Tuesday expressed optimism on the vote scheduled for later in the day to re-elect him to the leadership position.
A smiling Gingrich, (R-Ga.), arrived at the Capitol and told reporters "it's going to be a wonderful day."
Asked how the vote would go, Gingrich replied "I think we'll be fine."
Gingrich has been under a cloud over ethics problems related to a course that he taught.
